name: White nephrite (和田白玉, Hetian, Xinjiang)

diffuseAlbedo.note: The warm white of Hetian 'mutton-fat' nephrite; no measured colour was read: a first value read from museum photographs of Qing jade scroll knobs.

refractiveIndex.source: Nephrite (tremolite-actinolite) has indices of 1.600 to 1.627 (GIA Gem Reference Guide; Handbook of Mineralogy, tremolite)
refractiveIndex.note: The index read on a gemmological refractometer, the low end of the range for the iron-poor white stone.

porosity.note: A felt of interlocking fibres, one of the toughest stones worked; a first open porosity for a dense stone, no measurement read.

wettingDepth.note: So dense a stone takes up almost nothing: the depth whose pores govern the face's look when wet.

grain.note: Its tremolite fibres, microns across and felted: finer than the eye resolves on a knob.

bed.note: The faint cloud (the stone's 'cotton') a knob shows across its turned face.

bedAspect.note: A felt, with hardly any direction.

hurst.source: Candela et al. 2012, Journal of Geophysical Research 117, B08409 (fault surfaces, 0.6 to 0.8; cited in Stone.ush)
hurst.note: The middle of the range measured on rock surfaces, as the travertine's.

toneSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(albedo) across one face: an even white.

roughnessSpread.note: A first half-range of ln(roughness) across one face.
